Elaine (People Ops): Heads-up — we’re launching a 6-month pilot for two related time-off programs starting Sep 1. Goal is to give more flexibility for longer rest periods and better use of unused PTO. Details below.

Elaine (People Ops): 1) Paid Sabbatical (pilot): eligibility: full-time employees with 5+ years of continuous service; up to 6 weeks paid sabbatical; limited to one per 5-year window. 2) PTO Exchange (pilot): convert up to 40 unused PTO hours into either (a) 1 extra unpaid sabbatical week or (b) a one-time taxable payout.

Elaine (People Ops): Logistics: apply via the HR portal (people-ops > Time Off > Sabbatical/PTO Exchange). Deadline for first cohort: Oct 15. Managers must acknowledge coverage plan. Benefits (health/dental) continue during paid sabbatical; payroll continues for paid weeks.

Elaine (People Ops): Important constraints:
- Pilot window: Sep 1 — Feb 28.
- Blackout windows: Oct 15–Nov 5 (Q4 product launch freeze) — sabbaticals need exec approval if overlap.
- Not open to contractors/temporary hires.
- PTO Exchange is available after 1 year of service, sabbatical requires 5+ years.

Samir (Eng): Quick q — do part-time / reduced-schedule folks qualify at prorated levels?

Elaine (People Ops): Good question — part-time FT-equivalent employees will be considered on a prorated basis for both programs. Details and examples are on the portal doc.

Matt (EM): How will we handle headcount during someone’s sabbatical? any budget support for backfills?

Jen (People Ops): Managers should submit a coverage plan with the application. For critical roles we’ll discuss temporary backfill budget case-by-case with Finance; non-critical roles expect cross-team coverage.

Laura (Product): Does this impact promotion/comp cycles?

Elaine (People Ops): No — taking a sabbatical or using PTO Exchange will not pause performance reviews or compensation cycles. Normal review timelines stand; managers can request timeline adjustments in exceptional cases.

Samir (Eng): If I use PTO Exchange for payout, is that taxable?

Elaine (People Ops): Yes — the payout option is taxable and will appear on your W-2 as supplemental income. We’ll include a sample payroll calculation in the FAQ.

PeopleOpsBot: :calendar: Reminder — first cohort app deadline Oct 15. Submit via HR portal > Time Off.

Matt (EM): Nice, thanks. One more: can someone split their sabbatical into two shorter blocks?

Elaine (People Ops): For the pilot we prefer a single contiguous block to maximize restorative benefit, but we’ll consider splits for special circumstances — include a note in the application and People Ops will review with the manager.

Jen (People Ops): FAQ doc link in #people-ops pinned messages and in the portal. We’ll host two Q&A sessions (Sep 8 @ 10am PT and Sep 22 @ 4pm PT) — join whichever fits. RSVP via the calendar invite. :raised_hands:

Laura (Product): Thanks — excited to try this. :party_parrot:

Elaine (People Ops): Thanks all — we’ll post the full policy and template coverage plan in the portal now. Ping me or Jen if you want to discuss an edge case.
